numeric_collision_checks.bug_found_and_fixed: Player's own Collision7 node was being added as a static world collider, and CrateA/B/C + PillarA/B AABBs were computed before root.updateMatrixWorld(true), yielding un-transformed local-space bounds. Both fixed.

bugs_found_and_fixed_during_verification: Pointer-lock engage produced a synthetic huge movementX/Y (camera flip under floor) in Chromium/CDP-driven input; fixed by discarding the first mousemove event after each lock acquisition.
Player's own Collision7 rig node was incorrectly registered as a static world collider (self-collision bug); fixed by excluding any Collision* node that is a descendant of the Player node.

World collider AABBs for crates/pillars were computed before the loaded scene graph's matrixWorld was updated, yielding untransformed local-space boxes; fixed by calling root.updateMatrixWorld(true) immediately after adding the loaded scene to the graph.
Dead/incorrect code in the animate() loop (double camera-position assignment, stray unused variables, a tick() function defined after its own invocation) cleaned up.

Narrow-viewport (mobile/touch) HUD panels overlapped each other and the on-screen touch controls; fixed with a responsive stacked layout and a JS class toggle that relocates the legend panel when touch mode is active.
known_remaining_minor_issue: On very narrow viewports (~390px, e.g. iPhone 13 portrait) the title panel's subtitle text ('three.js r160') is very slightly clipped by its max-width, though it does not overlap any other element and the panel itself is fully legible. Not fixed further to avoid over-engineering the CSS for an edge case beyond the stated visual canon requirements.
